title: docs(pm-dispatch): whole-text restructuring PR-1 — state-machine and contract-review detail sink to references
body:
Part of #11086 — PR-1 of 2 of the adopted restructuring digest (maintainer 2026-08-23, verbatim: 「接受你的重构提案」, Q1–Q4 = A). The card stays open for PR-2 (lanes hoist-deletion ×7, seat-post connector fix, platform-readings consolidation); #11086 remains open.

## Scope delivered

- **NEW `references/state-machine.md` (43 lines, Q1=A)** — mechanism detail moved verbatim out of the four long state-table rows: `pm:on-hold` restart-line contract, dual channel, `Restart-touch:` trigger-file index and the two-step release check; `pm:blocked` done-work parking (`Unlock-action:`); `pm:awaiting-maintainer` exclusivity and exit; `pm:retriage` two-party hang/clear mechanics. The table rows shrink to one-line semantics plus a pointer.
- **NEW `references/contract-review.md` (44 lines, Q1=A)** — clause-② review-chain operational detail moved verbatim: dual-carrier hang/clear (2026-08-22 quotes), carrier non-migration (2026-08-18 quote), eligibility incl. the 2026-08-21 relaxation, downgrade fuse, subagent measurement facts and the anti-pattern sentence, quota-exhaustion non-exemption. **Q3=A applied**: the ownership sentence now reads current reality — standing owner = the skills seat's self-bound hourly cron (maintainer 2026-08-23, verbatim: 「要不还是你挂个定时处理审核吧」), the triage seat may still clear when tier-verified. SKILL.md keeps the gate principle, both limbs, and the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` single-source rule.
- **Q4=A** — the report-contract JSON block is dropped from SKILL.md; `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` 「终报消息」 is the single source (the two copies had measurably drifted). PM-side consumption rules kept. os-dev.md untouched.
- **Connector fact (ruling 5)** — 座位 Routine 三原则 ① now states the measured fact: credentials ride the Routine's attached repo sources; the Routines UI has no GitHub connector entry (measured 2026-08-23). seat-post-protocol.md's stale copy is PR-2's.
- **Q2=A** — two superseded-ruling narratives deleted (inventory below); guarded tombstones kept.
- **Dedups (one home each)**: patrol-interval numbers (kept in 收集, 停止条件 points at it) · hourly-fire rationale (stale under Q3 — replaced by a pointer to contract-review.md in the runbook, dropped from SKILL.md) · 借调 tombstone (kept in 多仓协调 4; runbook now points at it) · retired decision-digest (kept at the ⛔-不复活 tombstone with its quote) · hotcrm intake criteria (one-line pointer to `lanes/hotcrm.md`, which carries the charter verbatim).
- **Hoist (B1)** — the per-lane patrol-anchor first-duty sentence added verbatim once at the head of 执行座位职责; the 7 lane-file copies are PR-2's deletion.
- **Ratchet** — SKILL.md 682 → 666, dispatch-runbook 243 → 242 (lowering only), two new entries at 43/44; all headroom 0. Four-axis frame block untouched (`check:skill-frame-sync` green).

## Provenance proof (corpus = SKILL.md + dispatch-runbook.md + the two new files)

**Line counts**: SKILL.md 682 → 666 · dispatch-runbook.md 243 → 242 · state-machine.md 0 → 43 · contract-review.md 0 → 44.

**Dates** (grep `20xx-xx-xx`): 91 before → 91 after; no date leaves the corpus set. Multiset deltas, each accounted: 2026-08-11 10→9 and 2026-08-13 13→12 (Q2 removal 1); 2026-08-14 3→2 (Q2 removal 2; the day-shorthand "/15" in the same removed narrative leaves with it — 2026-08-15 never appeared as a full date anywhere else); 2026-08-19 11→12 (the retired-digest quote moved to the guarded tombstone, and the now-dangling 同日裁定 anchor was spelled out explicitly); 2026-08-23 1→3 (connector fact + Q3 ownership — both ruling-mandated additions).

**「」quotes** (wrap-normalized byte comparison): 193 tokens / 180 distinct before → 197 / 183 after. Set-identical except:

- **Sanctioned removal 1 (Q2=A)**: the 「⛔ 不落存储标签」 superseded-ruling parenthetical in the label-discipline bullet; the current rule and the pointer to the runbook 全序节 (where the 2026-08-13 quote lives) are kept.
- **Sanctioned removal 2 (Q2=A)**: the 「为什么要等我执行压缩」 supersession narrative in 波次收工点; the current rule keeps its 2026-08-09 date.
- **Sanctioned removal 3 (ruling 5)**: the Routines connector-fact clause (not a 「」token), replaced by the measured fact above.
- **Additions**: 「要不还是你挂个定时处理审核吧」 (the Q3 ruling itself); four section-name references in newly written connective prose (「回批入口」「收集」「状态模型」「终报消息」) and one extra 「入队与落地」 in the new file's provenance header — none is a maintainer quote.
- All moved maintainer quotes are byte-identical at their new homes (2026-08-21 relaxation incl. its fullwidth comma, both 2026-08-22 dual-carrier quotes, 2026-08-18 载体不迁移, 2026-08-19 retired-digest).

**Q3 authorized rewrite (the one non-verbatim move)**: the old ownership text — "常设 = 分诊席(Routine 模型由维护者在 Routines UI 钉在契约复审档位),分诊轮子轮清该标签仍是默认清标路径(达档席自清仅是后备)… 过渡期(分诊 Routine 未建成前)由 skills 席代行" — is replaced by the current-reality sentence in contract-review.md. Its operational clauses (contract-increment-only review, one-line verdict on the card, dual-carrier PASS clear, hourly batching) are carried verbatim.

## Deviations and honest readings

- **SKILL.md lands at 666, above the digest's 575–600 estimate.** The four state rows and the review-chain bullets are single physical lines in the file, so the mechanism move cuts content volume far more than line count (the review-chain deletion alone was ~1.3k chars on 4 physical lines). No re-wrap was used to force the number, per the dispatch's own ban.
- **B3 (seat-post section compression) is a no-op — the PM mechanism assumption is falsified.** Measured: seat-post-protocol.md systematically defers these details to the main file (「三招在主文件」, 「零建议与三类上报纪律在主文件」, 「批准出处在主文件」), so the SKILL.md copies are the only home and must stay. Nothing was deleted from that section.
- **B8 (author-identity-422 fallback) stays in SKILL.md.** landing-operations.md sits at its 82-line ceiling and I found no genuine in-place compression to pay the move with; per the dispatch, no ceiling raise, so the fallback text stays put.
